source: Manual requests to the FastAPI service (python -m uvicorn mizan.api:app) running the published model on an Apple MacBook Pro CPU, 15 Oct 2026. Copied from the terminal output; English glosses added for readers.

warm_latency_ms.note: After the model had loaded. The first request after start-up or an idle period took 0.7-6.6 s (plus a one-off 2.4 min model download).

variants.purpose: Same stolen-card request with one element removed at a time, to find what changes the prediction.
